refresh_ratios: 0.05 for all; 0.20 additionally for replicate 0, 4-GPU intents
calibration: static preceding data; or trailing14days reset every7days, strictly preceding predictions; explicit static pre-test fallback if fewer than100 recent paired observations
common_test: same timestamps across four lags and both intents; no job-log availability restriction

bootstrap.limitation: Descriptive sensitivity; rare-event zero-count degeneracy and nonstationarity prevent a general assurance claim.

warnings: Artificial domains group two anonymous measured hosts; no real federation/topology is inferred.
Public-subset job exclusion does not establish scheduler availability.
Per-minute GPU averages are not dynamic VRAM measurements.
All management-action costs are modelled, not measured network RTTs.
